description: This file provides utility functions for cryptographic operations related to organization IDs, including generating and decrypting organization IDs using AES encryption with a tenant salt, as well as validating the salt. It imports the CryptoJS library and a configuration value for the salt.

methods.name: hexToWordArray
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal string into a CryptoJS WordArray for cryptographic operations.

methods.name: generateOrganizationId
methods.description: Generates an organization ID by encrypting a normalized email address with a tenant-specific salt using AES-128-ECB and encoding the result for URL transmission.

methods.name: decryptOrganizationId
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted organization ID (URL-encoded Base64 string) back to the original email address, primarily for debugging purposes.

methods.name: isTenantSaltValid
methods.description: Checks whether the tenant salt is set and non-empty.
